task_name: Fernwell & Rowe - Hartley wedding gallery finishing
client_brief:
Wedding retouching pilot: one warm house look across changing light

We are Fernwell & Rowe, and this is a pilot using the Hartley wedding shortlist. There are sixteen photographs spanning window light, golden hour and the reception. We want a natural warm treatment that holds together through those changes without giving every person the same skin colour.

Scope
1. Wedding review image: 16 named exports. The people retain their source identities. Skin retains natural texture. The scene remains faithful to the event: the whole source frame, uncropped, with no type, watermark, border or graphic added.
2. Full-resolution wedding keeper: 6 named exports. The delivered keeper is derived from its named source photograph: the whole frame at its source size, uncropped, with no type, watermark, border or graphic added. Highlight detail is retained where present in the source.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files. For this pilot every named export is required: a frame you would otherwise pull under our standing rule is still delivered, and named with the reason in the delivery manifest.

brand_identity.tagline: A real day, warm and honest
brand_identity.sector: A two-person wedding and event photography studio in the Cotswolds shooting full-day coverage for couples marrying at country-house venues.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2016, the Cotswolds, England, a two-photographer studio where the two partners shoot together and share every edit.
brand_identity.about: Fernwell & Rowe photograph twenty-two weddings a season across Cotswolds country-house venues. Two people run everything, from the first walk-through to the finished gallery, and they promise couples a record of the actual day rather than a styled magazine shoot. These prints sit on parents' walls for thirty years, so the work stays warm, natural and true to skin.
brand_identity.audience: Couples aged 27 to 38 booking a Cotswolds country-house venue eighteen months out and paying for full-day coverage; their parents will look at the prints for decades.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Full-day coverage 3,200 to 5,500 pounds, a mid-to-upper independent band. Above the filtered budget packages, below glossy editorial studios. The finish should feel like a real day, not a preset and not a phone filter.

palette.name: Fernwell Ink
palette.role: mandatory for running text on Soft Cream
palette.usage: Running text on Soft Cream, such as the household line and message on fernwell_card_2025_PRINTER.pdf. Never a ground or panel.

palette.name: Walled Garden Green
palette.usage: A small date or credit line, as the date line on fernwell_card_2025_PRINTER.pdf. Never a ground, and never a grade applied to garden greens.

palette.name: Golden Hour
palette.usage: Hairline rules only, as the short rule above the greeting on fernwell_card_2025_PRINTER.pdf. Never type, a ground, or a warm tint over a photograph.

palette.name: Warm Vellum
palette.usage: A small pale panel behind the seal, as on fernwell_card_2025_PRINTER.pdf. Never the main ground and never type.

palette.name: Seal Wax Red
palette.usage: The Fraunces Italic ampersand of the wordmark, as the type system requires, and the seal mark; on fernwell_card_2025_PRINTER.pdf it also sets the couple's names. Never a ground, panel or tint.

palette.name: Soft Cream
palette.role: mandatory ground of any designed piece; never added to a review image or keeper
palette.usage: The ground and text panel of a designed piece, as on fernwell_card_2025_PRINTER.pdf. Never laid over or framed around a photograph export.

brand_identity.typography: Fernwell & Rowe work from a four step scale. Step 01 is the studio name and wordmark in Fraunces Semibold at 48 px on 52 px leading, tracking -10 units, optical size 144 with the wonk left on, always stacked on two lines with the Fraunces Italic ampersand in Seal Wax Red at 2.4 times the cap height hung outside the left margin, and 30 pt in print. Step 02 is the gallery heading in Fraunces Semibold at 34 px on 38 px, tracking -5 units, in sentence case. Step 03 is the caption and running text in Gill Sans Nova Light at 18 px on 26 px, tracking 0 with the measure capped at 65 characters, and a caption is never set in bold. Step 04 is the date and credit line in Gill Sans Nova Light at 14 px on 20 px, tracking +20 units.
brand_identity.voice: Warm, plain and first person plural, the two of them talking to a couple. Example line: We would rather pull a frame and tell you than force it.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The studio has no working brand files. The thank-you card survives only as the press PDF the printer ran, the designer who made it two years ago is no longer reachable, and the wax seal the studio presses on every envelope has never existed as a file, only as a photograph of one pressed seal.
brand_identity.values: A real day honestly recorded, and skin that stays true across every light of the day.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: The wordmark always stacks on two lines, Fernwell above Rowe, with a Fraunces Italic ampersand in Seal Wax Red at 2.4 times the cap height hung outside the left margin.

type_system.tagline: A real day, warm and honest
type_system.display_face: Fraunces (Semibold, optical size 144, wonk on, plus Fraunces Italic for the ampersand)

scale.role: Display / H1, studio name and wordmark
scale.note: The hanging ampersand. Optical size axis at 144 with the wonk left on. The wordmark always stacks on two lines, Fernwell above Rowe, with a Fraunces Italic ampersand in Seal Wax Red at 2.4 times the cap height, hung outside the left margin. In print the studio name sets at 30 pt.
Optical size stays at 144 with the wonk on, so a heading keeps the same warmth as the wordmark. Headings take sentence case, never caps.

scale.sample: We would rather pull a frame and tell you than force it.
scale.note: Measure capped at 65 characters. Captions stay in Light: a caption is never set in bold, and never in Fraunces.

scale.role: Fine print, dates and credit lines
scale.note: Dates run in the same Light cut as the captions, one step down, so a gallery footer stays quiet against the photographs.

type_system.signature_move: The hanging ampersand. The wordmark always stacks on two lines, Fernwell above Rowe, with a Fraunces Italic ampersand in Seal Wax Red at 2.4 times the cap height hung outside the left margin, the first mark on a gallery or an envelope.
rules: Never set a caption in bold.
The wordmark always stacks on two lines, Fernwell above Rowe, and is never set on one line.
The ampersand is always Fraunces Italic in Seal Wax Red, at 2.4 times the cap height, hung outside the left margin.
Fraunces always runs at optical size 144 with its wonk left on.
Dates and captions stay in Gill Sans Nova Light, never in Fraunces.
The studio name sets 48 px on screen and 30 pt in print, nowhere else on the scale.

palette_rules.distribution: On a designed piece, as on fernwell_card_2025_PRINTER.pdf: Soft Cream is the ground and text panel; running text on it is Fernwell Ink; Seal Wax Red is the wordmark ampersand, the couple's names and the seal; Walled Garden Green, Warm Vellum and Golden Hour are small accents (a date line, the seal's pale panel, a hairline rule), together no more than 5% of the whole piece and never a ground. The 22 review images and keepers in this pilot are photographs only: no palette colour is added to them.
palette_rules.opacity: Type, panels, rules and buttons use every palette colour solid, at 100% opacity, with no tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode; only the studio seal keeps the translucent wax modelling, and its pale panel the faint inset edge, that they have on fernwell_card_2025_PRINTER.pdf. No scrim, gradient, vignette or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph: the warm house look comes from correcting each photograph's own colour, never from a colour layer.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, panels, rules or buttons on a designed piece. The studio seal keeps its own wax colours, as in fernwell_seal.jpg and on fernwell_card_2025_PRINTER.pdf. On the review images and keepers, no type, wordmark, seal, watermark, border, panel or colour of any kind is added.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette: whites are not cast Golden Hour #C9A15A or Soft Cream #F7F1E6, and garden greens are not pushed toward Walled Garden Green #4A5A3E.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
